claim: In Q4 2024, Apple's net income came in at $12.5 billion or more.
summary: Apple's Q4 2024 net income exceeded $12.5B under both fiscal Q4 2024 (~$14.7B) and calendar Q4 2024 (~$36.3B) definitions, so the threshold claim is supported.

sub_claims.text: Apple's net income in Q4 2024 was $12.5 billion or more
sub_claims.note: From prior knowledge without external citations: Apple fiscal Q4 2024 (ended Sep 28, 2024) net income ~$14.736B exceeds $12.5B; calendar Q4 2024 (fiscal Q1 2025) net income ~$36.33B also exceeds. Threshold met under either definition.
